name: Bug Report / Feature Request
about: Report a bug or request a feature (agent-filled or human-filled)
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''

---

> **For AI agents:** fill every section with concrete facts. Replace
> placeholders. Attach console errors verbatim and, for bugs, a minimal
> repro PDF if small. Do not leave "TBD" — unknown fields say "unknown".

## Type

- [ ] Bug
- [ ] Feature request

## Description

Concrete description of the bug or feature. For bugs: what is broken, and
which build/URL was used (production `juyel-dev.github.io/...` or fork
preview `juyel-dev-s-org.github.io/...-forked/`)?

## Steps to Reproduce (bugs)

1. Go to '...'
2. Upload '...' (page count, file size)
3. Select layout '...' / preset '...'
4. Click '...'
5. See error

## Expected Behavior

What must happen (functional requirement).

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include verbatim console errors and network status.

## Environment

- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 126, Safari 17]
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS 14, Android 14]
- Device: [e.g. Desktop, Pixel 8, iPad Pro]
- Installed as PWA: yes/no
- PDF pages: [e.g. 45]

## Regression Check

- Reproducible on the fork preview build? yes/no
- First broken commit (if known): `git bisect` result or commit sha

## Additional Context

Screenshots, sample PDFs (small files only), HAR/console logs.
